metadata.title: झारखंड के 4 मंत्रियों के सामने सरकार की भारी आलोचना | Jharkhand Government
metadata.description:
The Jharkhand government today (15 May 2025) organised a special conference to deliberate on the new draft rules under the Provisions of the Panchayats (Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act, 1996 (PESA). The event saw the participation of key ministers from the Hemant Soren government, including Deepika Pandey, Deepak Birua, Ramdas Soren, and Shilpi Neha Tirkey.

Several tribal rights activists and community leaders strongly criticised the draft rules, accusing the government of diluting the spirit of PESA and sidelining the voices of Adivasis. Despite the intense scrutiny and sharp remarks, the ministers remained composed throughout the conference. In their response, they acknowledged the criticism and stated that the government views it as valuable feedback to strengthen the rules in favour of tribal self-governance.

Watch our full ground report to witness the powerful exchanges, hear from those at the forefront of the tribal rights movement, and understand what lies ahead for PESA implementation in Jharkhand.
